decisions.reason: Although submarine interior lighting is distant from our core range, it still leverages our maritime competence and appears to be a relatively low-commitment option worth keeping while demand uncertainty resolves.

The medical examination light builds on our established lighting capabilities and quality positioning, so in an expanding firm and growing industry we would keep this adjacent option absent clear negative evidence.
Industrial explosion-proof luminaires fit our industrial customer base and engineering strengths very well, making this a highly credible option to retain.
The designer task light is close to our existing offer and was relaunched as a proven product, so despite some market-style uncertainty it remains worth keeping on the market.
